caption: The video depicts an indoor, low-angle view of a window-mounted air-conditioning unit with its front cover removed, exposing the grey metal evaporator coil within a painted frame. A boxy side housing sits at the left, while behind the unit a window with mullions reveals other buildings outside, with a loose electrical cable running along the ceiling. A person's right hand, emerging from a black sleeve at the lower right, grips a black-and-yellow handheld spray tool whose nozzle is pointed into the right side of the open coil, a ribbed hose trailing downward. Throughout the excerpt the tool continuously emits a faint white vapor around its nozzle tip. This vapor drifts and thickens in several frames, indicating an ongoing spray process rather than a single burst. The hand makes small positional adjustments, shifting the nozzle slightly up, down, and across the right portion of the coil face while remaining aimed at the same general area. The air-conditioning unit, its coil, the side housing, and the window frame stay fixed in place, and only the hand, tool, and mist change relative to them. The overall camera framing drifts a little, consistent with minor handheld motion.
